property.name: test_pass_count
property.comment: the number of times the test passed.

property.name: test_fail_count
property.comment: the number of times the test failed.

property.name: test_timeout_count
property.comment: the number of times the test timed out.

query.name: build-test-list
query.comment: Get the list of tests for a build
query.sql: SELECT grp.id AS id, grp.name AS grp_name, test.id AS tid, test.name AS test_name, test.total_pass_count AS pass_count, test.total_fail_count AS fail_count, test.total_timeout_count AS timeout_count, run.duration AS duration, run.status AS status FROM porion_test_run_group AS rgrp INNER JOIN porion_test_group AS grp ON rgrp.group_id = grp.id INNER JOIN porion_test_run AS run ON run.group_id = rgrp.id INNER JOIN porion_test AS test ON run.test_id = test.id WHERE rgrp.build_id = :build_id ORDER BY grp.name, test.name
